name: Zia
overview: Zia is a male figure identified as a member of the tribe of Gad. His unique attribute is noted in 1 Chronicles 5:13, where he is described as a Gadite. Beyond this tribal affiliation and gender, Scripture provides limited information about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Zia appears in Scripture with a possible meaning of 'trembler,' as indicated in 1 Chronicles 5:13. This proper name is not noted as being given directly by God, and no additional titles are recorded.
familyAndRelationships: Zia is identified as a descendant of Gad, linking him to the broader genealogy of the tribe of Gad as recorded in 1 Chronicles 5:13. No further family relationships are documented in Scripture beyond this tribal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Zia's mention in 1 Chronicles 5:13 situates him within the genealogical records of the tribe of Gad, underscoring the importance of tribal lineage in the biblical narrative. Though details about his life and deeds are scarce, his inclusion affirms the preservation of the Gadite heritage within Israel's history.
